node.title: Re: Hash ordering
node.author: AnomalousMonk
node.doctext:
The statement
%key = sort keys %key;
takes the [doc://keys] (not the associated [doc://values]) of the hash, uselessly [doc://sort]-s them (because hash key/value pairs have no inherent order beyond their key/value pairing) and assigns the (pseudo)randomly ordered keys only back to the hash. Please see the discussions of [doc://keys], [doc://values] and [doc://each] in the Perl documentation, and also [wp://Associative array|associative arrays] (hashes). c:\@Work\Perl\monks>perl -wMstrict -le "my %alphas = ('a' .. 'x'); print qq{@{[ %alphas ]}}; ;; %alphas = sort keys %alphas; print qq{@{[ %alphas ]}}; " w x e f a b m n s t u v c d k l q r g h i j o p e g a c m o u w q s i k
